comments.body: DD2 GO-LIVE PREREQUISITE DISCOVERED (2026-06-05, matched-pair finding): enabling required_linear_history on the main ruleset (15629023) is NOT sufficient on its own — it must be flipped ATOMICALLY with the ruleset's pull_request.allowed_merge_methods. The live main ruleset had allowed_merge_methods=["merge"] (merge-commit ONLY), which (a) blocked ALL rebase-merges to main (every PR2 needed a manual/web-UI merge — observed 3x: cca8 #662/#664, 3ebb #667), and (b) would HARD-DEADLOCK with required_linear_history (linear forbids merge commits; allowed=["merge"] only permits merge commits -> no PR could ever merge). The matched pair for go-live: required_linear_history=ON AND allowed_merge_methods=["rebase"] (or ["rebase","squash"]), flipped together. The lintest/** experiment (DD2 mechanism proof) did NOT catch this because the throwaway ruleset lacked the allowed_merge_methods restriction — re-run the lintest experiment WITH allowed_merge_methods=["merge"] present to prove the pair before the live flip. INTERIM (2026-06-05): allowed_merge_methods set to ["merge","rebase"] (additive) to unblock rebase-merges now; narrow to ["rebase"] at the required_linear_history go-live.
